replies.author: FrozenSolstice
replies.body:
You worried about the movie?

Tell yourself this:

"If I never saw it, I wouldn't worry about it."

It works, if you never saw the movie, you would not be worrying about the aliens. This is purely because; A: There is no reason to worry, B: Your brain cannot worry about what it doesn't know.

If that doesn't work, feel free to reply and ask for more advice.
